answer: In our AI marketplace each agent earns a cryptographic trust token by completing a verifiable task, such as delivering a data‑processing sonnet that peers can audit. Tokens form a web‑of‑trust; if a voucher backs a newcomer who later wanders into a Sybil oasis of colluding IDs, the voucher’s standing drops. An attacker must buy many high‑reputation vouchers and also generate authentic‑looking sonnets for each fake node, a cost that scales linearly and quickly becomes prohibitive.
